alate: Dorsum of the head and the pronotum purplish brown, the pronotum with a pale T-shaped mark at the centre and a pale spot on each side near the anterior margin; the postclypeus yellowish brown, the anteclypeus greyish white; the mandibles dark brown along the marginal teeth and the periphery and brownish yellow at the base; the anterior half of the labrum reddish brown and darker than the posterior half, with a pale transverse band between them; the wings purplish brown. Pilosity of the head, thorax and abdomen medium in density; the base of the mandibles bears more than ten mandibular-base setae. Head nearly circular, the compound eyes rather small and nearly round, the ocelli round and slightly elongate; the fontanelle small, granular and projecting, situated at the centre of the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes; antennae with 19 segments, segment 2 about one and a half times the length of segment 3, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 4, the segments after the fifth almost equal, the terminal segment slightly larger and elongate-oval. Postclypeus slightly raised, its length slightly less than half its width, with a median longitudinal suture. Pronotum rather broad, its width about equal to or slightly less than the head width; the anterior margin shallowly V-shaped, without a distinct median notch; the posterior margin narrower and shallowly concave at the middle.
soldier: Head yellow or deep yellow, paler where the frons meets the vertex, the labrum deep yellow, the antennae yellow, the anterior half of the mandibles purplish brown and the posterior half becoming yellowish brown, the postmentum slightly darker than the rest of the head. Pilosity of the head medium in density, denser on the clypeus and frons; the anterior part of the postmentum with two to three long setae on each side. The apex of the labrum is narrowly rounded and does not reach the left marginal tooth. Mandibles slender and sickle-shaped, the apices slightly incurved; the tooth of the left mandible situated at nearly one-third of the anterior part with its apex slightly forwards; the right mandibular tooth very small, situated below the corresponding part of the left marginal tooth, with another indistinct granular small tooth near the base. Postmentum very broad and short, the sides of the posterior part nearly parallel, the posterior margin slightly contracted inwards and concave in a circular arc, the surface of the mentum rough. Antennae mostly with 16 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 the smallest, the terminal segment stout and nearly conical with a rather blunt tip. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe narrow and small, the posterior lobe broad and large, both the anterior and the posterior margin with a distinct median notch. The fore tibia is rather swollen; the hind tibia is about equal to or slightly shorter than the head width.
worker: Two forms, large and small; the large form is slightly darker in body colour than the small form.
